reads.sell: A German Riesling at Kabinett or Spätlese, lime, green apple and white peach over wet slate, its touch of sweetness balanced by electric acidity. Light and low in alcohol, it is superb with Thai or Vietnamese dishes, crab or smoked trout.

why.grape: Piercing acidity, lime and green apple with blossom and wet slate, low alcohol and pure, unoaked fruit are the Riesling signature; petrol joins them only after a few years in bottle.
why.climate: High acidity, low alcohol and tart, just ripe fruit say a cool continental vineyard near the northern limit for ripening grapes.
